name: Program Oral Interpretation
prompts: Did the program make one clear point?
Were the moves between pieces smooth?

tags.label: Program argument
tags.strength: The program made a clear point as a whole.
tags.toWork: Make the point of the whole program clearer.

tags.label: Transitions
tags.strength: Your moves between pieces were smooth.
tags.toWork: Make the moves between pieces smoother and clearer.

tags.label: Characters
tags.strength: Each character was clear and different.
tags.toWork: Make each character more different in voice and body.

tags.label: Script use
tags.strength: You used the script with skill and control.
tags.toWork: Handle the script more smoothly so it does not distract.

tags.label: Intro
tags.strength: Your intro set up the piece well and named the title and author.
tags.toWork: Use the intro to set up the piece and name the title and author.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
